cohort: Neonates born between 1993 and 2012 (144 cases with brachial plexus injury and 286 controls)
finding: Very few factors contributing to brachial plexus injury are modifiable, making it an unpredictable and likely unavoidable event.
mod_finding: Vacuum delivery was found to be an independent risk factor for brachial plexus injury only among primiparous women.
